# GSD Show DAG Queue

Render an eligible-only, capability-oriented pipeline readiness report using the
Orchestrator and `.github/skills/gsd-show-dag-queue/SKILL.md`.

## Intent

Provide the operator with a single, self-contained readiness view showing what
can actually be staged and shipped next, organized around cohesive features and
useful capabilities with plain-language explanations, DAG dependency matrices,
and narrative target choices. This prompt is read-only and never claims
shipments or mutates backlog planning state.

## Inputs

* `scope`: Optional filter (`all` default, `stash`, `queue`, or `track`).
* `format`: Optional layout (`full` default, `table`, or `matrix`).

## Requirements

1. Route through the Orchestrator and execute `.github/skills/gsd-show-dag-queue/SKILL.md`.
2. Sync the backlog index (or scan all configured item sources when using a
   stashless adapter such as `backlog-md`); when shipment workflows are enabled
   (`features.shipments: true`), run `gsd gate dag-readiness --json`,
   report `active` shipments as in-flight without probing `pre_claim`,
   and run read-only `gsd gate pipeline-topology --mode agent --shipment <id> --phase pre_claim --json`
   only on `queued` candidate shipments (otherwise evaluate task
   dependencies directly).
3. Filter to eligible-only stash and queue items, excluding shipped/archived,
   held (`HOLD`), externally blocked, and obsolete/superseded items.
4. Lay out eligible work in table and DAG dependency matrix format oriented
   around cohesive features and capabilities linking `-S`, `-DL`, `-F`, `-T`,
   and stash IDs with plain-language explanations.
5. Close with an executive narrative and self-contained priority options
   conforming to the Operator Choice Presentation Rule, awaiting explicit
   operator selection before triggering Stage, Ship, or `/gsd-dark-mode`.
